title: eludite.test.run output
description: The run: its id and, once it finished (or the wait ended), its summary and the failed tests with their messages.

run.description: The run's id (eludite.test.results and eludite.test.cancel take it).

state.description: building, discovering or running while it goes; passed (no test failed), failed, canceled.

tests.description: How many tests the run covers.

summary.description: Counts over the tests the run covers, and its time so far.

not_run.description: Not reported yet (still to run, or canceled before they ran).

failed.description: The failed tests (at most 50), each message cut at 2,000 characters (`truncated`).

name.description: The fully qualified name (with a data row's arguments: the display name).

message.description: The failure message or the skip reason, cut at the budget (`truncated`).

output.description: What the test wrote (eludite.test.results only), cut at `max_output_chars`.

source.description: The file and line of the failure's first stack frame in the project, else where the test is declared.

truncated.description: The message, stack trace or output was cut.

timed_out.description: The wait ended before the run did.
